label: correct
description: Full UC2 adjustment set {budget, dim, ls, nl, snr}. snr is technically redundant given ls and nl (snr = ls/nl), but including it enables direct SNR moderation estimation (UC2) and is the canonical set used throughout UC1–UC3.

label: drop_snr
description: Omit derived confounder snr (keep ls and nl). Because snr = ls/nl, conditioning on ls and nl already blocks all snr backdoor paths — expected near-zero bias.

label: drop_snr_related
description: Omit all SNR-related confounders (ls, nl, snr).

label: empty
description: Naive unadjusted ATE — no covariates at all.

label: add_non_confounder
description: Correct set + initial_design_quality (non-confounder: affects outcome but not strategy). Should be harmless.

label: collider
description: Correct set + observed_flag (collider: caused by both strategy and outcome). Introduces downward bias via Berkson's paradox: conditioning on the collider attenuates the within-stratum strategy-outcome correlation (observed empirically: -41% bias).
